claimSelectionRule: currency_id = TokenAddress(addr), asset kind Sidechain => Bridge.receiveByEthereumAssetAddress(addr, amount, to, from, txHash, v, r, s)
currency_id = TokenAddress(addr), asset kind SidechainOwned (VAL) => VAL master.mintTokensByPeers(addr, amount, to, txHash, v, r, s, from) -- note argument order
currency_id = AssetId(id), asset kind Thischain (XOR, PSWAP, ...) => Bridge.receiveBySidechainAssetId(id, amount, to, from, txHash, v, r, s)
amount, to, from, txHash, v, r, s are taken verbatim from ethBridge_getApprovedRequests; never recompute the amount (denomination and precision conversion are already applied by the chain)
before sending, eth_call used(txHash) on the claim contract; true => done, do not send
legacy XOR master 0xc08edf13… is decommissioned: never call it
